sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: Affirmation was built to keep authority human; confidence from relations is testimony and cannot by itself become authority.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: The charter's Office over Testimony ruling (srs decision 16b20c56) says testimony is promoted into office only by a verification mechanism, such as a signature or a ratified decision. A confidence score built from relations is testimony. SP-71 and decision c373c2c1 exist because agents imitated authority acts. The fake-decision warning (81f2bf49) applies equally to a score whose basis the owner never sees. Decision 9d50126b carries its own revisit trigger: when changes built on suggested meaning are reverted more often than the care modes predict. And the owner keeps some things affirmed on purpose (a5a9c651).

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Does relation-derived confidence need a promotion step before it can rank or merge work? Which acts must stay offices (ratify, merge, set the period's priorities) whatever the confidence?
